title: lifecycle.rs comment contradicts is_peerable for SmtpListId
description: lifecycle.rs line 791 says 'SMTP drain articles are peerable' for SmtpListId. injection_source.rs is_peerable() returns false for SmtpListId. run_post_pipeline hardcodes NntpPost anyway. Three contradictory signals about SmtpListId peerability. The lifecycle.rs comment is stale. Remove or update it to match is_peerable().
